Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring contracts to be awarded to the lowest responsible bidder.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the openness and fairness of public worksbidding; adding a new section to chapter 39.30 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that fair andopen competition is a basic tenet of public works procurement, thatsuch competition reduces the appearance of and opportunity forfavoritism and inspires public confidence that contracts are awardedequitably and economically, and that preservation of the integrity ofthe competitive bid system dictates that, the contract should beawarded to that responsible bidder submitting the lowest responsive bidunless good cause is shown.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: After bids for a public work, as defined in RCW 39.04.010, havebeen opened by the state or municipalities, as defined in RCW39.04.010, and institutions of higher education as defined in RCW28B.10.016, award must be made to that responsible bidder who submitted p. 1 HB 1444the lowest responsive bid, unless it is determined in writingspecifying the reasons that there is good cause to reject all bids andcancel the invitation. The requirements of this section shall alsoapply to general contractor/construction managers' procurement ofsubcontract bid package work under RCW 39.10.061, except that both thepublic owner and the contractor/construction manager must determine inwriting specifying the reasons that there is good cause to reject allbids and cancel the invitation.
